svg.title: Firefly system architecture
svg.text: Everything that listens for danger runs on her phone. The cloud talks, texts and tracks.
· the Firefly web app (React), opened from a link
Scream detection never leaves the phone

text.tspan: · PIN cancels · any other code = silent alarm

svg.text: Event bus · walk.started · speech.heard · danger.signal · alert.state · pin.entered
Lantern route with turn-by-turn · GPS every 5 s · calm countdown screen · live mic meter · demo mode
One AWS Lambda behind one HTTPS link
a private link for her people
API keys stay on the server.
The phone only gets a token
a 10-s clip when an alert fires.
live audio · only her voice · short-lived token
She picks home and taps once.
The mic opens, the route lights up.
The firefly chats out loud. Only
her voice is sent to transcribe.
A scream, her code phrase or no
Her PIN cancels. Any other code
looks the same but calls for help.
Her people get a text with her live
Solid lines: requests and data · dashed: live audio stream · Firefly never calls real 911 (the dispatch call goes to a demo number)
